note.text: Synthetic placeholder payer, per the UC02b source appendix (which labels it 'Commercial Dental PPO (Synthetic) — to be filled with actual payer'). Unlike UC02a's DentaQuest or UC01's Independence Blue Cross (real payers), no real commercial dental PPO is named here — a deliberate choice, not an oversight. EDI and endpoint identifiers are synthetic test-data values. If a real payer is chosen later, this Organization is the single place to update the name.
